title: REQ · Round model with 13 statuses, transition table and round.yaml store
summary: Round struct, legal transition table and atomic round.yaml persistence
description: Context: world.Round only reads id/number/status/times. Desired behavior: a round package defines statuses SCHEDULED, OPEN, CLOSED, ANALYZING, PLANNING, DEVELOPING, TESTING, BUILDING, PUBLISHING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED, RECOVERING, a transition table, and a FileStore reading and writing worlds/<world>/rounds/<round-lowercase>/round.yaml. Expected result: illegal transitions are rejected. Why: single source of truth for the lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: Given status SCHEDULED, when transitioning to OPEN, then it succeeds; to CLOSED it returns ErrIllegalTransition
Given a saved round, when Get is called, then the same fields are returned including base_release and freeze_commit
Given an unsafe world or round id, when Get or Save is called, then an error is returned and nothing is written

preserve: worlds/<world>/rounds/<round>/ path convention used by contribution.FileStore

technical_constraints: Write via temp file then os.Rename
definition_of_done: round package compiles with table and store
